standard: Cortex 2.1.0 brains.md §5 standing memory checks (BR-10, BR-11, BR-16, BR-18, PL-13)
productionBasis: Production columns are judged from the code at the recorded deployed commit 7dae7051 (orchestrator image sha256:cb2e6922) or marked NOT_VERIFIED; no live image or bucket was inspected. The deployed lake-brain image (brain-jobs:a6622f99) is from feat/lake-consolidated, not main, so Lake production is NOT_VERIFIED.

checks.title: Knowledge store and owner declared; research data never a runtime fallback
No developer-machine, private research root or Claude session path in runtime or deploy code
Release id and digest verified on load and recorded in lineage
Missing or corrupt memory fails safe, degrades explicitly or abstains, with a test
Research, operational state and publication separated; release approval record
Runtime does not depend on Sector Pulse, a Mac or localhost
